import html # Example template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ Safe Response
{user_content}
""" def generate_html_response(user_content: str) -> str: """ Generates an HTML response by safely embedding user-provided content into a template. Parameters ---------- user_content : str The raw text supplied by the user. This string may contain characters that need to be escaped to prevent injection of malicious HTML or scripts. Returns ------- str A fully-formed HTML document with the escaped user content inserted into the template. """ # Escape all special characters to neutralize any potential HTML/JS injection. safe_content = html.escape(user_content, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
